description: Actual catalog imported skins/materials, CourierMotion manual simulation at 240 Hz, existing CourierLightingRig/profile. Gameplay instance scale/offset and camera pose/FOV match OriginalPlayController; gameplay images use portrait 9:16. Disposable stage follows NativeRhythmRules.JumpY at fixed input speed 6.5; camera follows forward motion, diagnostic cameras also follow flight height. Short hops are consecutive: PlayLanding then PlayJump at the same contact, as in ordinary gameplay. The final contact plays Idle and Landing. No bone overrides, fake poses, saved scene, chart, model, music, collider or project-setting changes. Sheet cells are row-major; labels show cell number and seconds. World AABBs and weighted-foot centroids come from CPU-baked imported vertices. Roll and scale are relative to the bound visual pivot rest pose. Diagnostic cameras are fitted once from all three rest silhouettes with a 60% motion margin, then frozen for baseline/candidate.
